subject: FLA causal-conv micro parity HOLD; GPU released
body: Committed FLA-full causal-conv adapter/probe ran on RTX3050. Forward parity PASS (cosine ~0.999996, max abs <=0.001953), cached update output/cache PASS, grad_x PASS. Probe status HOLD because synthetic BF16 grad_weight/grad_bias max_abs reached 0.0625 against predeclared 0.05 cutoff in larger cases, despite cosine ~0.999997. Qwen3.5 actual conv1d is bias=False, so grad_bias failures are architecturally irrelevant. No threshold is being relaxed post hoc. Next experiment will bind actual Qwen3.5 conv config, bias=None, and add relative-L2/norm-aware gradient metrics before any backend promotion. No model weights changed. GPU released.
